allow: PowerShell(Copy-Item "$PWD\\dotfiles\\whkd\\whkdrc" "$env:USERPROFILE\\.config\\whkdrc" -Force; $p = Start-Process whkd.exe -PassThru -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\\whkd-err.txt"; Start-Sleep 2; if \(Get-Process -Id $p.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\) { "whkd alive id=$\($p.Id\)"; Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force } else { "DIED:"; Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\whkd-err.txt" })

PowerShell(Get-Process komorebi,whkd,yasb,komorebi-bar -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Sleep 1; $env:KOMOREBI_CONFIG_HOME = "$env:USERPROFILE\\.config\\komorebi"; & komorebic.exe start --whkd --bar 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; Start-Sleep 3; Get-Process komorebi,whkd,yasb,komorebi-bar -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name, Id | Format-Table)
